entries.name: Death Knight
entries: The Lich King Ner'zhul created death knights from fallen warriors and paladins to serve as undead, immortal lieutenants of the Scourge in the Third War. Arthas Menethil was the first of these death knights, and after Arthas became {@creature Lich King Arthas|WoW|the Lich King}, the power of the death knights only grew stronger. (See "{@book The Scourge|WoW|6|The Scourge}" in chapter 6 for more information.)

During the invasion of Northrend, a company of death knights was freed from the Lich King's control. These knights claimed a flying necropolis as the headquarters for the Knights of the Ebon Blade. Under the command of Highlord Darion Mograine, they dedicated themselves to the protection of Azeroth. After Bolvar Fordragon took on the Lich King's mantle, he ordered his lieutenants, the Four Horsemen, to call forth a new generation of death knights to join the Ebon Blade.

Death knights engage their foes in melee, supplementing weapon attacks with unholy magic. They drag foes into one-on-one conflicts and wield their magic to draw enemy attacks and prevent enemies from fleeing their grasp.
